title: Square Jacobi SVD HDL Optimized
source_docs: Fixed-Point Designer HDL Support/Matrices and Linear Algebra/Matrix Factorizations/Square_Jacobi_SVD_HDL_Optimized.md
text: 定点奇异值分解，输入 4 路、输出 5 路；按 {Select outputs} 指定模块输出；{Dimension of matrix A} 指定方阵 A 的维度、{Number of Jacobi iterations} 指定 Jacobi 算法的迭代次数、{Signal type} 指定输入矩阵 A 的复杂度，按实例取值。

ports.name: A
ports.summary: 方阵 A real or complex square matrix

ports.name: readyIn
ports.summary: 下游模块是否已就绪 scalar

ports.name: restart
ports.summary: 是否清除内部状态 scalar

ports.name: U
ports.summary: 左奇异向量 unitary n -by- n matrix

ports.name: V
ports.summary: 右奇异向量 unitary n -by- n matrix

ports.name: validOut
ports.summary: 输出数据是否有效 Boolean scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: 模块是否就绪 Boolean scalar

params.name: Dimension of matrix A
params.values: 方阵 A 的维度 n (default) | positive integer-valued scalar

params.name: Number of Jacobi iterations
params.values: Jacobi 算法的迭代次数 10 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Select outputs
params.values: 模块输出 UsV (default) | Us | sV | s

params.name: Signal type
params.values: 输入矩阵 A 的复杂度 real (default) | complex
